statement.excerpt: Its unraveling will be framed as impossible to see coming because nobody in power had bothered to look.

from_speaker: will be framed as impossible to see coming

our_interpretation: Its refers to the AI-demand boom discussed immediately beforehand.
Unraveling means a substantial, sustained, broad reversal in demand, rather than a stock-price correction or one company's failure.
Will be framed means a widespread public explanation by relevant decision-makers and commentators, rather than one isolated quotation.
The sentence predicts both an unraveling and its subsequent explanation. I do not convert it into a conditional forecast that assumes a collapse.
The causal explanation requires evidence about prior scrutiny; retrospective surprise alone would not establish that nobody investigated.
criteria.support_condition: A broad AI-demand collapse occurs, representative subsequent accounts portray it as unforeseeable, and records substantiate the asserted failure of prior scrutiny.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a qualifying collapse and a sufficiently developed public record, representative explanations acknowledge that it was foreseeable. Documented prior scrutiny would also undermine the categorical causal explanation.
